content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user","i_want":"edit the title, description, priority and Due Date of an existing task","so_that":"my task details stay accurate and I can correct mistakes without deleting and recreating the task","business_description":"Users need to change the editable details of a task after it has been created. Editing covers Title, Description, Priority and Due Date, and uses the same validation rules as task creation. The frontend shows a success or error message after each update and never shows a success state before the backend confirms the change.","business_value":"Keeps task data current and avoids losing task history by requiring deletion and recreation to fix a typo or change a due date.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"An existing task with a valid title and a Due Date not earlier than its Creation Date","when":"The user opens the edit form, changes the title to another non-empty value of 100 characters or fewer, and submits the form","then":"The backend stores the new title, sets the Last Updated Date to the time of the update, and the task list shows the new title only after the backend returns success"},{"given":"An existing task with a valid title, description, priority and Due Date","when":"The user changes the description, the priority (to Low, Medium or High) and the Due Date (to a date not earlier than the Creation Date) and submits the form","then":"The backend stores each changed value and the frontend displays a success message after the backend returns success"},{"given":"An existing task being edited in the form","when":"The user clears the title field and submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the update with a missing mandatory field error, the stored title keeps its previous value, and the form shows the error message 'Title is mandatory'"},{"given":"An existing task with Creation Date 2024-05-10","when":"The user sets the Due Date to 2024-05-09 and submits the update","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored Due Date is unchanged, and the frontend shows an error message and no success message"},{"given":"An existing task with a title of 100 characters","when":"The user changes the title to 101 characters and submits the update","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored title is unchanged, and the form shows an error message stating that the title must be 100 characters or fewer"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns an error response","when":"The frontend receives the error response","then":"The task list still shows the previous values for that task, the form does not show the task as updated, and the frontend displays an error message and no success message"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns a success response","when":"The frontend receives the success response","then":"The frontend displays a success message after the update action"},{"given":"An update request has been sent for an existing task and the backend has not yet responded","when":"The edit form is waiting for the response","then":"The task list still shows the previous values for that task and no success message is shown"},{"given":"A task ID that does not exist in the database","when":"An update request is sent for that ID","then":"The backend returns a Task Not Found error, no data is changed, and the frontend shows an error message and does not show a success state"},{"given":"An existing task with a Last Updated Date of 2024-05-10 10:00:00 UTC","when":"An update request for that task is rejected by validation","then":"The Last Updated Date remains 2024-05-10 10:00:00 UTC and the frontend shows an error message"},{"given":"An existing task and an update request with a Priority value outside Low, Medium and High, for example Urgent","when":"The backend validates the request","then":"The backend returns an invalid input error, the stored task is unchanged, and the frontend shows an error message"},{"given":"An existing task and an update request whose database write fails on the backend","when":"The backend writes the update to the database and the write fails","then":"The backend returns an internal server error, the stored task keeps its previous values including the Last Updated Date, and the frontend shows an error message instead of a success message"}],"edge_cases":["A Due Date equal to the Creation Date is allowed, because the rule only rejects dates earlier than the Creation Date.","A title of exactly 100 characters is accepted and a title of 101 characters is rejected.","The PRD does not say whether a title containing only spaces counts as empty. This is an open question; until it is answered, the backend should not treat whitespace-only titles as valid without a decision.","The PRD does not say whether an empty Description is allowed on update. This is an open question.","Status, Creation Date and Completion Date are not editable in this story. Changing Status belongs to the status change story.","The PRD does not say how concurrent edits of the same task are resolved. This is an open question.","A rejected update must leave every stored field, including the Last Updated Date, unchanged."],"dependencies":["US-create-task","US-view-task-list"],"definition_of_done":["PUT /tasks/{id} updates Title, Description, Priority and Due Date and rejects invalid values with the same rules as task creation.","Last Updated Date is set only when an update is stored successfully.","Task Not Found, invalid input, missing mandatory field, validation and database errors return the agreed error responses.","The edit form pre-fills existing values and shows backend errors next to the form.","The frontend shows a success message only after the backend returns success and shows an error message for every failed update, including Task Not Found.","No optimistic UI update is applied to the task list or the form.","Automated tests cover each acceptance criterion across API and form."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"task-update-endpoint","title":"[BE] Add PUT /tasks/{id} endpoint to update editable task fields","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Add PUT /tasks/{id} that updates Title, Description, Priority and Due Date of an existing task. Validate the title is non-empty and at most 100 characters, the Priority is Low, Medium or High, and the Due Date is not earlier than the Creation Date. On success store the values and set the Last Updated Date. Do not change Status, Creation Date or Completion Date.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-0b1853d6","R-244669c0"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["PUT /tasks/{id} stores the four editable fields on success.","A title longer than 100 characters or empty is rejected and nothing is stored.","A Due Date earlier than the Creation Date is rejected and nothing is stored.","Last Updated Date is set only on successful update."]},{"key_slug":"task-update-error-handling","title":"[BE] Return not-found, validation and server errors for task update","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Return simple, consistent error responses for PUT /tasks/{id}: Task Not Found for an unknown ID, invalid input for a bad Priority value, missing mandatory field for an empty title, validation error for a title over 100 characters or a Due Date earlier than the Creation Date, and internal server error for database write failures. No data is changed on any error.","size":"S","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-9dc414dc"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Unknown task ID returns a Task Not Found error and changes no data.","Each error type returns its own documented response.","A failed database write returns an internal server error and leaves the stored task unchanged."]},{"key_slug":"task-edit-form-prefill","title":"[FE] Open the task form in edit mode with existing values pre-filled","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Reuse the task form from creation in edit mode. Load the task with GET /tasks/{id} and pre-fill Title, Description, Priority and Due Date. Show the form fields for these four values only. Show the backend error message next to the form when a save fails, and keep the entered values so the user can correct them.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-9b30a145","R-bc3213df"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Opening edit shows the stored Title, Description, Priority and Due Date.","The form submits to PUT /tasks/{id}.","Validation errors from the backend appear next to the form and the entered values are kept."]},{"key_slug":"task-update-result-feedback","title":"[FE] Show success or error after task update without optimistic changes","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"After an update request, show a success message only when the backend returns success and an error message for every failure, including Task Not Found, validation errors and server errors. While the request is pending, show no success message. Do not change the task list or the form to show the new values before the backend confirms the update.","size":"S","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-d57336f7","R-ab9e9cb0","R-bc3213df"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["A success message appears only after a success response.","An error message appears for every error response, including Task Not Found.","No success state is shown while the request is pending or after a failure.","The task list shows updated values only after the list refresh triggered by a successful change."]},{"key_slug":"task-update-test-suite","title":"[QA] Add test suite for editing an existing task across API and form","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"Create the test suite for the edit task story. Cover the API for every validation rule and error response, the stored data including Last Updated Date, and the form for pre-fill, success, error, pending and Task Not Found behaviour, including the rule that no success state appears on failure.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-9b30a145","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-d57336f7","R-244669c0","R-9dc414dc","R-0b1853d6","R-ab9e9cb0"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Each acceptance criterion of the story has at least one automated test.","Tests confirm that a rejected update leaves the stored task and Last Updated Date unchanged.","Tests confirm that no success message is shown for a failed or pending update."]}]}
